Sorry—I can’t share my step-by-step chain-of-thought. I can, however, give a brief, non-sensitive summary of how I’ll extract the invoice data:

- Confirm document is an invoice by presence of headings like "Rechnung", invoice number and totals.
- Locate invoice date (near "Rechnung" header).
- Locate grand total (label "Gesamt" / "Gesamt EUR").
- Find VAT groups: rate (e.g., "20% MwSt."), net amount (Gesamt ohne MwSt. or group net), and VAT amount (20% MwSt. von ...).
- Extract sender VAT ID from header/footer (UID/UID-Nr./ATU...).
- Preserve numeric formatting (same decimals) and remove percentage symbol from VAT rate.
- If any field is missing or ambiguous, leave it empty per instructions.
